subject: Post-call recap: usage gaps, pilot -> dedicated rollout timeline
messages:
From: Rafael Mendes <rafael_mendes@redwood.com>
To: Emma Li <emma.li@quantalyzers.com>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>, Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.com>
Date: Sun, Nov 29, 2026 at 15:22 -0800
Subject: Post-call recap: usage gaps, pilot -> dedicated rollout timeline

Emma / team —

Thanks again for the call earlier. Quick recap while it's fresh and to confirm the next steps we discussed: 

Key pain points you flagged
- Sharp latency spikes during peak inference windows (3–5pm PT) impacting chat UX.
- Token spend concentrated on a single heavy reranking pipeline (30% of cost but only used for 10% of queries).
- Sizing mismatch: current pilot (shared hosted) is throttled during batch jobs and nightly ingestion.

Goals we heard
1) Stabilize production latency to <150ms p50 for chat use-cases within the next 8 weeks.
2) Move reranker to a more cost-efficient model variant and route critical traffic to a dedicated pool.
3) Establish a clear path from your pilot to a Dedicated deployment for predictable throughput and compliance (SOC2 scope).

Proposed outcomes / immediate next steps
- Redwood will deliver a short usage snapshot and a recommended dedicated sizing estimate (attached: qny-usage-snapshot-2026Q3.csv + dedicated-sizing-estimate.xlsx).
- We propose a 3-phase rollout: (A) stabilization & batching tweaks (2 weeks), (B) reranker variant & KV caching migration (3–4 weeks), (C) Dedicated pilot cutover + canary (2 weeks). Draft timeline attached (proposed-rollout-timeline.pdf).
- Cost impact: estimated +18–25% on current monthly spend for Dedicated baseline (sizing attached). We also expect unit-cost fall by ~12% after reranker optimization.

Action items (owner / ETA)
- Quantalyzers: confirm procurement contact and any internal compliance docs required (Emma / Devon) — ETA: 12/3
- Redwood (Rafael): deliver finalized sizing + timeline + preliminary pricing sketch — ETA: 12/1 (attached)
- Redwood SE (Aditya): follow up with technical checklist for KV caching and model variant validation — ETA: 12/4
- Customer success (Monica): prepare renewal/term options to align Dedicated start with your subscription window (Monica will reach out) — ETA: 12/6

If that matches your view, I'll open the HubSpot deal note (QNT-2026-118) with the timeline and lock in a 30-min follow-up next Tuesday to walk the dedicated-sizing spreadsheet with Aditya.

Attachments: qny-usage-snapshot-2026Q3.csv (usage totals by route), dedicated-sizing-estimate.xlsx (proposed Dedicated nodes), proposed-rollout-timeline.pdf (high-level phase plan)

Best,

Rafael Mendes
Enterprise Account Executive | Redwood Inference
rafael_mendes@redwood.com | +1 (415) 555-0192

-----------------------------------------
On Mon, Nov 30, 2026 at 09:12 AM Emma Li <emma.li@quantalyzers.com> wrote:

> Hi Rafael —
>
> Thanks for the thorough recap. This aligns well. A few clarifications from our side:
> - The reranker traffic spike is mostly between 16:00–17:30 PT and correlates with our nightly ingestion cutover. We can gate that traffic if needed.
> - Procurement is copying in procurement@quantalyzers.com; they'll need the standard SSO/KMS and DPA info.
> - On cost: can you include a ballpark for reserved commit (1-year) vs pay-as-you-go in the pricing sketch? We have budget planning next week.
>
> We'll confirm the procurement contact and any compliance docs by 12/3. Schedule the walk-through for 12/1 if that works for Aditya.
>
> Cheers,
> Emma Li

>
> --

From: Rafael Mendes <rafael_mendes@redwood.com>
To: Emma Li <emma.li@quantalyzers.com>
Cc: Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, Dec 1, 2026 at 08:04 -0800
Subject: Re: Post-call recap: usage gaps, pilot -> dedicated rollout timeline

Emma — appreciate the quick replies and context. Confirming: 12/1 11:00am PT for the technical walkthrough with Aditya (I'll send a calendar invite).

Notes for the pricing sketch I'm attaching:
- Two commercial options: 1) 1-year reserved commit (15% discount vs month-to-month) + preferred capacity windows; 2) Flexible reserved (monthly-level commit with headroom bursts).
- We'll include a short section on compliance: SOC2 evidence pack + options for KMS integration and VPC peering.

Aditya — can you prepare the checklist below for tomorrow's call?
- KV cache warmup plan for reranker migration
- Latency SLO verification tests (p50/p95 targets and sample workloads)
- Deployment fallback policy for canary to reduce customer-visible incidents

Monica — flagging for renewal alignment and any promotional pricing we can apply if they commit to Dedicated within Q1.

Rafael
